info.name: London Property Sales API
info.description:
Flask and MongoDB API for searching and analysing property sales in Greater London (COM661 CW1).

Data: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data, 2026, Greater London only, grouped into one document per address. The details sub-document (bedrooms, bathrooms, floor area, features) was generated and is marked synthetic: true.

Contains HM Land Registry data (c) Crown copyright and database right 2021. This data is licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

Roles: guest (no token) can browse and search; user can also write reviews and use analytics; admin can also manage properties and sales.

Authentication: log in to receive a JWT and send it in the x-access-token header.

Input: all POST and PUT requests use form data (x-www-form-urlencoded).

Before running: set admin_username, admin_password, user_username and user_password in the collection variables. Run the folders in order; folder 3 creates a test property that later folders use and folder 7 deletes.

item.description: Open to everyone, including guests with no token. Supports pagination (pn, ps), filters (district, postcode, property_type, tenure, bedrooms, min_price, max_price) and sorting (price_asc, price_desc, newest, oldest). Price filters and sorting use the most recent sale, worked out with an aggregation pipeline.
